messages.subject: New Shiny Component for Handsontable
parts:
https://gist.github.com/xiaodaigh/6441107

I making a Shiny Component for Handsontable. It's still in development but I am publishing it as I heard Mr Jeff Allen is also developing. My one was inspired by initial example by yannrichet at https://github.com/yannrichet/try-shiny

I am trying to make it so that it is both an input and output component at the same time. I find this quite nice.

Hopefully Jeff if you can hear me so that we can share the code and save some work on both sides. Maybe I can save some effort as I am quite new to JavaScript and just follow your code.
